offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures radiopharmaceutical diagnostic imaging agents and radioisotope generators for hospitals, imaging centers and nuclear pharmacies. It makes and sells these products to help physicians diagnose cardiac, cancer and neurological disease.

primary_products.value: ultrasound contrast agents; PSMA PET prostate cancer imaging agents; amyloid PET brain imaging agents; myocardial perfusion imaging agents; molybdenum-99 technetium generators

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, imaging centers, nuclear pharmacies, radiopharmacies and PET manufacturing networks

revenue_model.value: product sales: imaging agents and generators sold to hospitals, imaging centers and pharmacies

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: markets its own branded imaging agents to physicians and hospitals; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures radiopharmaceuticals and generators, sold to hospitals and radiopharmacies

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: diagnostic imaging agents, PET imaging agents, radioisotope generators and contrast agents

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling directly to hospitals and imaging centers; distributors / dealers: radiopharmacies and nuclear pharmacies that distribute radiopharmaceuticals; partners / resellers: PET manufacturing networks and commercial partners that supply imaging agents
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: imaging agents need FDA approval, radioactive materials need NRC and state licenses

notes: Product and partner details are from general knowledge and may have changed.
